description: Need a GAIP receipt in another ecosystem's shape? Pass `receipt_id` and `format`: `x402` (Settlement Attestation Receipt proposal style), `erc8004` (validation-response shape for off-chain publication) or `vc` (W3C-VC-like JSON-LD). Unsigned: integrity via hash chain and Merkle proof only; no on-chain write. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).
name: gaip_receipt_export
title: Export a GAIP receipt
